caption: The drawing is in black ink on a beige background and shows three views of a chair: a side view on the left, a partial profile of the seat in the center, and a front view on the right. The side view depicts the backrest as slightly curved, with the seat cushion forming a right angle at the front and legs descending vertically, featuring a beaded trim along the seat edge. The center section provides a dashed outline of the seat, illustrating its profile. The front view displays four straight, tapered legs supporting a rectangular seat, above which is an elaborate shield-shaped chair back with three vertical decorative rods and a central fan-like motif, all framed by curved lines. At the bottom left, the scale reads "Scale, Two inches, One foot," and there is a signature "Livingstone" at the bottom right.
title: Side Chair
